Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro:
This privacy policy informs data subjects (visitors and users of Konfiguruj) about the processing of personal data in line with Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation, “GDPR”) and Section 19 of Act No. 110/2019 Coll., on the processing of personal data, as amended (Czech law).

“Personal data” means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person. “Processing” means any operation or set of operations performed on personal data (collection, recording, organisation, structuring, storage, disclosure, use, restriction, erasure, etc.).

controller.title: Controller
controller.body: The controller of personal data is the operator of the Konfiguruj online service, whose identity and contact details are given on this site’s contact page (the “controller”). For matters relating to data protection, please use in particular the contact e-mail shown on that page.

categories.title: Categories of personal data

purposes.title: Purposes and legal bases
purposes.body:
We process personal data for the following main purposes and on the following legal bases:

1) Providing the Konfiguruj service, creating and managing your user account, performing a contract or taking steps at your request before a contract — legal basis: performance of a contract under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.

2) Handling quote or offer requests sent through the service — legal basis: performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR, or where applicable the controller’s legitimate interest in handling business communication under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

3) Complying with legal obligations to which the controller is subject (accounting, tax law, cooperation with public authorities) — legal basis: legal obligation under Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.

4) Ensuring secure operation, fraud prevention, and records needed to protect the controller’s rights — legal basis: legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, balancing your rights and freedoms.

5) Processing based on your consent where we explicitly ask for it (e.g. marketing beyond what is necessary for the contract) — legal basis: consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR; you may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.

We do not carry out solely automated decision-making with legal or similarly significant effects within the meaning of Article 22 GDPR in the ordinary operation described here.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body:
We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which they are processed, or for as long as required by applicable law (e.g. archiving, accounting and tax rules, limitation periods).

Account data are usually kept for the duration of the contractual relationship and thereafter for the period necessary to exercise rights and obligations arising from the contract and from law. Request data are kept for as long as needed to process the request and then for periods corresponding to limitation periods and any disputes, unless a shorter period applies.

After that period we delete or anonymise the data so that they are no longer personal data.

recipients.title: Recipients and processors
recipients.body:
We disclose personal data only to the extent necessary to persons or entities that process personal data on our behalf as processors under Article 28 GDPR (typically hosting providers, server infrastructure, e-mail services), and only on our instructions.

On request, we will provide further information about categories of recipients or processors through the controller’s contact details.

We do not sell personal data. Transfers to countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA) take place only where an adequate level of protection is ensured under Chapter V GDPR (e.g. adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses); in such cases we will inform you of the transfer and safeguards.

rights.title: Data subject rights

contact.title: Exercising your rights and enquiries
contact.body:
To exercise the rights above, or for questions about this policy or our processing, please contact the controller using the e-mail address on this site’s contact page. We will respond without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt of the request; in justified cases this period may be extended under Article 12(3) GDPR.

We may update this policy from time to time; the current version is always published on this page. We may notify you of material changes where circumstances require it.

Privacy.disclaimer: This text is provided for general information; you should have it reviewed by a lawyer for your specific situation.

CookiesPage.title: Cookie information
CookiesPage.intro:
This document describes how we use cookies and similar technologies in connection with the Konfiguruj web application.

Processing of personal data related to cookies is governed primarily by Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation, “GDPR”), Act No. 110/2019 Coll., on the processing of personal data, as amended, and, as regards storing cookies on your device, Act No. 127/2005 Coll., on electronic communications, as amended (Czech law).

definition.title: What cookies are
definition.body: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser or on your device when you visit a website. They may be used to recognise your device, keep you signed in, or ensure basic service functionality. Similar purposes may be served by other storage technologies in the browser (e.g. local storage) when used for the same ends.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary cookies
necessary.body:
These cookies are necessary to display the site securely, operate your user account, and perform the contract for the service; without them the application cannot work properly. Their use is covered by Section 89(3) of Act No. 127/2005 Coll. and does not require your prior consent under the cookie rules of that Act.

This category includes cookies related to sign-in, session maintenance, authentication tokens, and technical cookies that ensure availability, stability, and security of the service. We do not use them for targeted advertising.

optional.title: Cookies that require consent
optional.body:
Marketing, analytics, or other non-essential cookies that go beyond what is strictly necessary would only be stored on the basis of your prior, freely given consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR and the relevant provisions of Act No. 127/2005 Coll.

At the time this text is published we do not deploy such optional cookies in the service. If we add them later, we will inform you beforehand and obtain your explicit consent; you may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.

browser.title: Browser settings and refusing cookies
browser.body:
Most browsers can be configured to limit how cookies are stored, delete them when the session ends, or block them entirely. The steps depend on your browser (usually under “Settings” / “Privacy and security” / “Cookies”).

Please note that blocking or deleting all cookies, including essential ones, may limit or prevent some features of the service, especially sign-in and account use.

controller.title: Controller, data subject rights, and supervision
controller.body:
The controller of personal data in connection with operating the service is the person or entity identified on this site’s contact page. You may direct questions about processing to the contact e-mail shown there.

Under the GDPR you have, among others, the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, objection, data portability where applicable, and the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

In the Czech Republic the supervisory authority is the Office for Personal Data Protection (Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů), Pplk. Sochora 27, 170 00 Prague 7, www.uoou.cz.

SketchUpTutorial.title: SketchUp Plugin Tutorial
SketchUpTutorial.subtitle: How to export Dynamic Components for the Konfiguruj configurator
SketchUpTutorial.metaDescription: Step-by-step tutorial for using the Konfiguruj SketchUp plugin to export Dynamic Components to the web configurator.
SketchUpTutorial.intro: The Konfiguruj Export plugin exports Dynamic Component parameters from SketchUp to a zip file (model.glb, parameters.json, materials) that you can upload to the configurator. Your model must use Dynamic Components with configurable parameters.

installation.title: Installation
installation.step1: Download the .rbz file using the button above.
installation.step2: In SketchUp: Window → Extension Manager → Install Extension.
installation.step3: Select konfiguruj_export.rbz. The plugin appears under Plugins → Konfiguruj Export.
installation.extensionManagerCaption: After installation, Konfiguruj Export appears in Extension Manager (Manage tab).
installation.extensionManagerAlt: Extension Manager showing Konfiguruj Export with version, author, and signed status

supportedEntities.title: Supported entities
supportedEntities.intro: The plugin reads Dynamic Component attributes from:
supportedEntities.groups: Groups – with Dynamic Component attributes in the dynamic_attributes dictionary
supportedEntities.components: Component instances – with Dynamic Component attributes
supportedEntities.componentsFigureCaption: Example setup: a parent component with nested parts (e.g. top, legs) in the Outliner / Component Tree, and custom attributes on the parent in Component Attributes.
supportedEntities.componentsFigureAlt: SketchUp workspace with Component Attributes and Component Tree showing a hierarchical model and dynamic component attributes

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.dimensions: Dimensions: LenX, LenY, LenZ, width, height, depth (and Czech: sirka, vyska, hloubka, prumer)
parameters.formulaParent: Parent!param – references a parameter from the parent group/component
parameters.formulaComponent: ComponentName!param – references a parameter from another component (e.g. stul!leny)
parameters.definitionFigureCaption: Define custom attributes on the parent component; nested parts reference them with formulas such as =parent!param_name (dimensions, materials, etc.).
parameters.definitionFigureAlt: Component Attributes dialog showing parent custom parameters and child components using parent! references for LenX, LenY, LenZ, and materials

effects.title: Effect types
effects.scale: scale – scale mesh on axis (x, y, z, xz)
effects.position: position – position mesh from formula (e.g. from LenY)

workflow.title: Export workflow
workflow.step1: Open a SketchUp model with Dynamic Components.
workflow.step2: Select the root group or component that contains your parameters.
workflow.step3: Plugins → Konfiguruj Export → Export for Konfiguruj.
workflow.step5: Upload the zip to the configurator via Import from SketchUp.
workflow.exportMenuCaption: Run export from the Plugins menu (labels match your SketchUp language).
workflow.exportMenuAlt: Plugins menu with Konfiguruj Export submenu and Export for Konfiguruj highlighted
workflow.outputFigureCaption: The saved zip unpacks to a folder with model.glb, parameters.json, and a materials/ folder with PNG textures (when the model uses them).
workflow.outputFigureAlt: File browser showing exported folder: model.glb, parameters.json, and materials subfolder with texture PNGs

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.intro: If the plugin does not export anything:
troubleshooting.debug: Run Plugins → Konfiguruj Export → Debug and check the Ruby Console (Window → Ruby Console) for entities and parameters found.
troubleshooting.selectRoot: Ensure the root group/component with parameters is selected before running Export.
troubleshooting.debugFigureCaption: Use Plugins → Konfiguruj Export → Debug; the Ruby Console shows which components and parameters the plugin sees (e.g. Dynamic Component keys and exported parameter names).
troubleshooting.debugFigureAlt: SketchUp Plugins menu with Debug selected and Ruby Console displaying Konfiguruj Export debug output

materials.title: Materials
materials.description: Only textured materials are exported as PNG. Color-only materials are skipped; the configurator supports textures. Dimension parameters are exported in cm (SketchUp returns inches; the plugin converts).

list.title: Pricing rules
list.helpPricingRules: Each rule adds an amount to the product base price when its condition matches the customer’s configuration. "Equals" applies to a single value; "Range" applies when the number falls between two bounds. Rules for different attributes add together: the final price is the base price plus the sum of all matching rule amounts.
list.helpComponentsAttributes: Components are the main parts of your product (for example tabletop, legs, frame). Each component has attributes—what customers configure, such as size, material, or color. Pricing rules always target one attribute on one component, so the surcharge applies only when that part of the configuration matches.
